comparison.objective: Load a CNC tool magazine while leaving empty pockets on both sides of a face mill; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests tool-holder grasping, keyed/pocket insertion, and magazine arrangement; candidate tests fine adjustment-tool use, counterholding, locking torque, and repeated dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct magazine occupancy and neighboring clearances; candidate requires two compliant stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Magazine loading and adjacency planning do not test damping adjustment. No spec versions or insertion/retention and collision thresholds are available.
